protocol.comparability: Identical seeded guest arrival times, venue demands and order release times across candidates. Robot parking/base poses vary with the design. Kitchen pickup remains fixed.
limitations: Three deterministic seeds are a robustness probe, not an empirical statistical validation.
Incomplete visits/cycles at the fixed horizon remain incomplete. Completed-trip means are conditional on completion; compare counts first.
Network-distance values are observer-only shortest paths between quantized 0.5 m grid nodes.
No measured human stress, live hotel traffic or calibrated robot navigation is claimed.
